headline: Solomon’s developer story
intro: Software Engineering student building practical, well-documented products across web, mobile, AI, productivity, and personal finance.
contactText: Have a placement, freelance project, or collaboration in mind? Let’s talk.

profile.name: Solomon Osayande-Johnson
profile.role: Software Engineering Student & Freelance AI Software Engineer
profile.bio: I’m organised, logical, and calm under pressure, with experience supporting people, managing my own schedule, and building practical software.
